intro.headline: I'm Herman.
positions: Research Intern @ MARS Lab, PES University

summary: Robotics and Edge AI engineer with hands-on experience building and deploying autonomous drones and mobile robots on real hardware. Currently working at PES University's Mobile and Autonomous Robotic Systems (MARS) Lab, developing ROS 2–based SLAM, perception, and navigation systems using IMU–LiDAR fusion and monocular vision.
